name: Rib jacquard (designer photo) in deep midnight navy

source.license: supplied by the designer for Perhaps packaging

height.note: ribs read deep in the photo; distance chosen, not measured

measured.note: colour map mean; sheen tinted navy so the cloth reads rich, not grey

limitations: Built from one draped photo: relief is the lighting-flattened luminance, not a height scan.
Mirrored 2 x 2 to repeat without a seam, so the jacquard blocks repeat symmetrically every 40 mm.
Physical scale assumed: 2.2 mm rib pitch (23 px).
